about.label: About Reagle FX Empire
about.title: Building Traders Who Win With Discipline
about.story: CoachPeter founded Reagle FX Empire to transform beginners into confident, disciplined forex traders. From Kigali to the world, his mentorship blends real market experience with a community-first approach.
about.mission: Our mission is to democratize professional-grade forex education — making institutional-level strategies accessible to every ambitious trader in Africa and beyond.
about.experience: With years of live market execution and hundreds of students guided through volatile conditions, CoachPeter delivers mentorship that is practical, honest, and results-driven.
about.philosophy: Trade with a plan. Protect your capital. Grow with community. That is the Reagle FX Empire way.

pay.title: Unlock full student access
pay.subtitle: Pay with MTN or Airtel MoMo. Instant reference code · live classes · paper trading desk.
pay.flowStep1: 1. We create a pending payment with your unique reference code.
pay.flowStep2: 2. You pay via USSD dial or manual transfer to the coach MoMo number.
pay.flowStep3: 3. Submit your transaction ID — admin or API confirms → access unlocked.
pay.disabled: Payments are temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
pay.completeSubtitle: Use USSD (recommended) or send manually, then submit your transaction ID.
pay.methodUssdDesc: Opens your phone dialer with the payment code prefilled.
pay.dialerCopiedHint: USSD copied. If the code is empty in your dialer, long-press and paste.
pay.dialerPasteHint: Open your phone dialer and paste the USSD code shown above.
pay.dialerFootnote: On some phones the full code must be pasted after the dialer opens (especially from Chrome on a hosted site).
pay.methodManualDesc: Send money from your MoMo wallet to the coach number.
pay.manualStep1: Open MTN MoMo or Airtel Money on your phone.
pay.manualStep2: Send the exact amount to the coach number above.
pay.manualStep3: Put the reference code in the message/note if possible.
pay.confirmDesc: After paying, paste the transaction ID from your SMS or MoMo history.
pay.txSubmitted: Transaction ID saved. Waiting for confirmation (usually a few minutes).
pay.failedHint: This payment was rejected or failed. Start a new payment or contact support.
pay.referralHint: Share your link — you earn a reward when friends pay for the first time.
